name: Vasai-Virar
scopeLimits: The ranked WUP population-weighted point is a settlement locator, not a parcel identity, municipal boundary, or coverage guarantee. No full polygon geometry is retained.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
registryBasis: Vasai-Virar City Municipal Corporation's official Marathi property-tax page links to a local Property Mapping service, while its corporate map page identifies the corporation. The linked mapping route opens a citizen RTS service that requires registration/login and does not expose an anonymous cadastral download. Maharashtra's official BhuNaksha is an additional statewide map-with-land-records service, but no city parcel sample was verified.
technicalBlocker: The state BhuNaksha landing page is described by official search-index content as an interactive state/category/district/taluka/village/parcel selector, but its web-reader open reports a redirect loop and direct anonymous HTTPS requests to index.jsp and index.html timed out before any HTTP response. No locality API, cookie/redirect route, or vector service was exposed.
remainingUncertainty: Whether an anonymous session can reach the city-survey or locality selectors in BhuNaksha from another network, and whether the viewer serves safe public vector geometry rather than only record-level maps/cards. Direct network transport failed before the redirects/cookies could be observed.
nextStep: Inspect the official municipal property-mapping service and Maharashtra BhuNaksha through a public map session without logging in or selecting a person's record; retain only a bounded geometry-only reply if the viewer documents an anonymous vector route.

officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 official Vasai-Virar City Municipal Corporation page, Marathi text; lines 233–253 list municipal property-tax services and link Property Mapping to onlinevvcmc.in.

officialSources.method: GET via web reader following the official Property Mapping link
officialSources.observation: HTTP 200 RTS page states citizen must register, submit supporting documents and pay certificate charges; it is a transactional property-services page, not a public parcel API.
Official Maharashtra land-records portal lists free/paid land services, BhuNaksha maps, property cards and city-survey-number search; no anonymous city vector endpoint identified.

officialSources.method: GET via official state map portal search result
officialSources.observation: Interactive BhuNaksha map landing page presents State/Category/District/Taluka/Village and parcel-number selectors; direct web fetch redirected in a loop. No parcel was selected and no geometry was requested.

portals.name: VVCMC Property Mapping / RTS portal
portals.observation: Official corporation page links Property Mapping, but the route lands on a citizen RTS property service with required registration/login. No parcel polygons were requested.

portals.name: Mahabhunakasha
portals.observation: Statewide interactive maps-with-land-records viewer; the opened landing page requires administrative and parcel selection and provides no confirmed city-wide vector endpoint.

viewerAndServiceTrace.summary: The official BhuNaksha landing page is indexed with state/category/district/taluka/village and parcel-number selectors; web-reader open reports a redirect loop. Two direct HTTPS requests (index.jsp and index.html) timed out before HTTP response, preventing cookie and redirect tracing. No locality/parcel number was selected and no geometry requested.

attemptedGeometry.outcome: No anonymous parcel geometry query was made because no bounded public vector endpoint was identified.
